# QS-CFW-4540-42 — Quality specification - flange blank CFW-4540-42 (4140)

Revision: Rev D  
Plant: P3  
Parts: CFW-4540-42

Scope
This document specifies the quality acceptance criteria and inspection method for flange blank CFW-4540-42 (CFW-4540-42) forged from 4140 material in Plant P3. It applies to all supplied flange blanks prior to heat treatment handoff and final shipment.

Requirements table

| Requirement | Specification |
|---|---|
| Material identification | 4140, part CFW-4540-42 |
| Hardness | The hardness range for flange blank CFW-4540-42 (CFW-4540-42) is 38-44 HRC. |
| Bore diameter tolerance | The bore diameter tolerance for flange blank CFW-4540-42 (CFW-4540-42) is ±0.07 mm. |
| Maximum forging weight | The maximum forging weight for flange blank CFW-4540-42 (CFW-4540-42) is 71.9 kg. |

Inspection method
Visual inspection: Verify identification stamping and absence of scale, cracks, or laps. Dimensional inspection: Measure bore diameter using calibrated bore gauge or micrometric instrumentation traceable to plant calibration. Confirm bore diameter falls within nominal drawing dimension plus or minus the specified tolerance; record measurement on inspection record. Hardness testing: Perform Rockwell hardness test per plant procedure using HRC scale on representative locations across the rim and hub. Record individual readings and confirm they fall within the specified hardness range. Weight verification: Weigh the forging on calibrated scale and confirm weight does not exceed the specified maximum forging weight. Maintain inspection records with part traceability and inspector signature.

Nonconformance handling
Any item found outside the specified values in the requirements table is nonconforming. Segregate nonconforming parts and notify Quality. Disposition options include rework, acceptance by engineering deviation, or scrap. Rework must restore the part to meet the listed specifications before release. Final disposition and returns to production require signed approval by Quality.
